column1: # Normalisation vectors, shared by the builder and the app (T-0205).
# Three tab-separated columns, no header row:
#   fold    fold::normalise - lower case, accents and apostrophes dropped, й/ї/ё
#           folded to и/і/е, ł to l. The builder folds a stored name with it and
#           the query folds the typed text with it, so a row here is a promise
#           that both sides see the same word.
#   words   fold::canonical_words - fold, then split on anything that is not a
#           letter or digit, with a digit-led token absorbing a short letter
#           suffix. The expected column is the words separated by one space.
# This file is read by two tests, never copied: `fold::tests` in the crate, and
# `NormalisationVectorsTest` in the app, which calls the generated Kotlin
# bindings of the same functions. A change to the fold on one side alone fails
# Add a row for every spelling class in a commit that changes the fold. Keep the
# expected column exact: a row that "looks about right" hides the drift these
